source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Layers' (PDF 12-13): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network layers communication ke process (amal) ko chhote hisson mein baant deti hain. Har layer ki ek khaas responsibility (zimmedari) hai. Data in layers se step by step (qadam ba qadam) guzarta hai. Is structure (banawat) se network ka design simple (saada) aur organized (munazzam) hota hai. Ek layer mein tabdeeli doosri layers par asar nahi karti. Layered communication reliability (bharosa) aur control behtar karti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Chitthi bhejne ki misaal: aap chitthi likhte hain, lifafe mein band karte hain, pata likhte hain, daakkhana use chhaant'ta hai aur gaari le jati hai. Har qadam ka kaam alag hai; agar gaari badal jaye to aap ko chitthi likhne ka tareeqa nahi badalna parta. Layers bhi aisi hi hain.

blocks.prompt: "Ek layer mein tabdeeli doosri layers par asar nahi karti" ka kya faida hai?
blocks.explanation: Kisi ek layer (maslan cable ki jagah Wi-Fi) ko badalne ke liye baqi layers ko dobara banana nahi parta; network ka design saada aur munazzam rehta hai.

items: Layers: baat-cheet ke chhote hisse, har ek ki zimmedari; data qadam ba qadam; ek layer ki tabdeeli doosri par asar nahi.
